blocks.text: How2Recycle label program (How2Recycle / GreenBlue). Source description: How2Recycle is North America's most recognized on-pack labeling system that clearly communicates disposal instructions to the public. We aim to eliminate consumer confusion and drive responsible packaging design to improve the quality of recycled materials. Full text is not stored (license: link_only). See https://how2recycle.info/.
